minor.issue: List serializer hard-codes display_meta={} for every item. After a successful PATCH /api/inspirations/archive/{id}/display-meta (which persists correctly — verified via direct GET /api/inspirations/archive/{id}), the list endpoint still returns display_meta={}. Not blocking for the Inline Regia frontend flow (the popover holds its own state and uses the block.metadata.display_meta path), but the persistent display preferences are invisible on subsequent moodboard reopens that re-fetch via the list. Recommend including display_meta in the list serializer for consistency.

integration_issues.issue: Could not directly capture img.style.objectPosition / img.style.filter / img.style.transform after Regia interactions because of third-party tracker (PostHog session recorder) overriding the HTMLInputElement value setter — Playwright el.evaluate threw 'Illegal invocation' on the zoom slider. Architectural shape is correct (popover present, controls wired, screenshots show the focal marker and filter strip live), but main agent should self-verify the live propagation by manually clicking the focal stage and a filter and inspecting the block inline style.

rca of the issue: Minor backend list-endpoint issue: the /api/inspirations/archive serializer in routers/inspirations*.py returns display_meta as a hardcoded {} (likely an oversight in the response_model — the column is selected and persisted by PATCH but not surfaced in the list mapper).
